messages:
Ethan M: FYI prospect HelioFinance needs SOC 2 redacted report, ISO 27001 cert excerpt, a signed pen-test authorization, and a simple network diagram showing staging vs prod. They also want confirmation about key custody for Private deployments (KMS/HSM) before running a vendor scan. Who owns the attestation and can we confirm KMS separation language?

Jules A: We can provide redacted SOC2 + ISO excerpt + control mapping. Legal signs pen-test auth. For Private deployments, we have two KMS options: customer-managed keys (BYOK) or Redwood-managed KMS. If they need BYOK evidence, Security can provide a keyflow diagram and attest to separation.

Rae K: Ops note: authenticated scans to staging are fine via timeboxed jumpbox tokens + presigned S3 for evidence. We do NOT provide persistent host creds. If they want scans against a single-tenant dedicated pool or their Private deployment in their VPC, we need detail on key custody because that changes access patterns.

Sam P: Legal can sign our standard template. If the buyer requests changes to indemnity, we escalate. Also ask the vendor for COI and ATO before we approve any scan.

Ethan M: Customer specifically asked: can the attestation reference that KMS is customer-controlled when they choose BYOK? They want that in writing for their audit.

Jules A: Yes — we can add a line: "Customer-managed key option (BYOK) places key custody with the customer; Redwood Inference does not retain customer keys when BYOK is selected." Legal will review exact wording.

Rae K: Pricing/ops: if they want a 10h reserved window on a 6x A100 dedicated warm pool, rough estimate is ~$3,200 infra + ~$600 ops = ~$3.8k. If scan targets their Private VPC we may need an ops day for network validation (~$900).

DeployBot: Pre-signed upload created: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/helio-3115004321 (expires in 48h). Upload vendor scope + COI + vendor ATO to /helio/vendor-scan/.

Ethan M: Action items: 1) Sam to prepare pen-test attestation template with optional BYOK language. 2) Jules to attach keyflow diagram and control mapping. 3) Rae to confirm final ops quote with capacity team. 4) Customer to upload vendor docs to presign link.

Sam P: I'll draft the attestation and include two variants: one that references BYOK custody and one generic. We'll ask the buyer which to use. If they submit redlines that expand liability, flag for exec review.

Jules A: Uploaded keyflow diagram + control mapping draft to the presigned link. :white_check_mark:

Rae K: Re cost: pinged capacity, will post final numbers by EOD. VPN instead of IP allowlist adds ~1 business day and an additional setup fee.

Ethan M: Thanks team. I'll update HelioFinance with the presigned link, the preliminary ~$3.8k estimate, and the BYOK attestation option. Tagging @Sam P for redlines when they come in. :thumbsup:
